QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_17

answer.text: Start-ups or 'early stage' businesses with high growth potential

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 17 of the workbook describes venture capital investing as direct investment in infant companies, start-ups, or early-stage businesses with high growth potential. The Trap: Listed companies, established banks, and real estate are not the venture capital target set; pp.35-36 reinforce this by contrasting the Category I (which houses venture capital funds) and Category III AIF universes. Note: Workbook references — p.17 (venture capital targets early-stage/start-up businesses with high growth potential) and pp.35-36 (Category I versus Category III AIF contrast).
